entries.task: Production Supabase authentication, RLS and progress persistence verification
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: The local repository does not contain production administrative credentials or permission to inspect/alter the live project.
entries.what_credential_or_action_is_missing: Authorized Supabase project access and production test account.
entries.exact_owner_action: Provide authorized Supabase access or run the documented production smoke checklist.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: Application auth guards, local content validation, and local learning-flow fixtures are present.

entries.task: Enable Google OAuth in Supabase and Google Cloud
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: Provider secrets and dashboard configuration are external to this repository and must not be committed.
entries.what_credential_or_action_is_missing: Google Web OAuth client ID/secret and Supabase dashboard access.
entries.exact_owner_action: Follow GOOGLE_AUTH_OWNER_SETUP.md: enable Google in Supabase Auth > Providers, add the client ID/secret, set Google callback https://szqpkxlatzvwcxpwmewt.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback, and allow the application callback origin used by deployment.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: Continue with Google button, safe redirect restoration, auth-callback.html, loading/error handling, and session handoff are implemented.

entries.task: Deploy protected Premium content tables and RLS
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: The public static curriculum cannot be made a secure commercial paywall without authorized Supabase schema/RLS deployment.
entries.exact_owner_action: Deploy the protected catalogue/preview/lesson-body schema described in PREMIUM_CONTENT_SECURITY.md, enable entitlement-backed RLS, then run the Free direct-access denial test.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: Access manifest, showcase/free-preview metadata, entitlement fixture, pricing UX, migration guidance, and security tests/contracts are prepared.

entries.task: Activate a real Premium payment provider
entries.why_owner_authority_is_required: A payment account, merchant terms, and production webhook secrets require owner/business authorization.
entries.what_credential_or_action_is_missing: Approved payment provider account, plan IDs, webhook endpoint and secrets.
entries.exact_owner_action: Choose and authorize a provider, set the central Premium price/plan configuration, connect checkout and webhook entitlement updates, then run a paid-to-entitlement smoke test.
entries.what_local_work_is_already_complete: Free/Premium comparison page, provider-independent upgrade boundary, honest pre-launch pricing state, and local entitlement fixtures are implemented.
